color-mix() [--accent-selection/--accent-wash]
:focus-visible selector
logical props (inline-size/inset-block-start)
clamp() type + spacing scale
position:sticky (status bar)
tabular-nums (count-up, no reflow)
space-separated rgb w/ alpha (vignette)
color-scheme: dark light
underline thickness + offset (link rule)
svg data-URI background (grain)
SELECTION SWATCH — must be dark rust, never magenta
ACCENT WASH — must be faint rust, never magenta
